{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Exclude rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
filtered_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping row with highest sample_seq
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates
deduplicated_df = filtered_df.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Now, print only the numbers that will appear in evidence
# These must be directly produced by the code and not inferred

print(f"Number of -999 values in 'biomarker_baseline': {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")
print(f"Number of rows after filtering out -999: {len(filtered_df)}")
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(deduplicated_df)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {deduplicated_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()}")"}
